description: Selected annual organic control/operator metrics plus reference rows for control-system roles.
quality_rules: Keep import_status visible in all downstream use.
Rows marked staged_needs_reconciliation_or_precision_note require table-level review before external publication.
Sector and survey rows are usable for internal analysis with source-type flags, but should not be presented as neutral official statistics.
known_gaps: Iceland area and market series remain needs_primary_check; operator register and 2040 policy target are separately sourced.
KRAV rows are private-label metrics and must not be merged with official all-organic operator/area statistics.
Okologisk Norge, NORSOK and Luomuinstituutti are not yet integrated.
